item.description: J. Cole is set to close out his The Fall Off Tour at FNB Stadium on 12 December 2026, marking his first South African show in a decade. As Africa’s largest live music venue with a 94,736 seat capacity, the stadium previously hosted Travis Scott’s sold out 2025 concert, setting a high benchmark. item.title: Nomfundo Moh Set to Release New Album Titled “Farm Julia”
item.description: Nomfundo Moh has announced that her new studio album, “Farm Julia”, will be released on 3 April 2026. The upcoming project follows a series of successful releases, including her debut album Amagama (2022), her second album Ugcobo (2023), and her third studio project Twenty Four (2024), as well as her 2025 EP Out The Box and the single “Umathandana Wami”.
